primary_intent: First-pass single-equity research on 澜起科技 / Montage Technology (688008.SH, plus its 06809.HK H-share line), focused on whether reported profit growth is real and whether the price already embeds it
secondary_intents: Separate core from non-core earnings: TTM reported net margin 49.9% against 扣非 net margin 36.6% is the whole question
Establish an expectation baseline from the THS F10 consensus (17 institutions) and test whether the current multiple is justified by it
Assess the Korean antitrust investigation as a position-level risk the company itself declines to predict
execution_order: Route (first_pass_research, deep_dive) -> acquire the CNINFO primary disclosure chain -> recompute the reported figures -> derive TTM / single-quarter / valuation multiples -> cross-check derived against vendor-served values -> expectation anchor -> earnings-quality separation -> actionability gate
market_scope: A-share STAR board (CN) with an H-share line
time_boundary: Financials 2016..2026H1; market data 2019-10-08..2026-09-30; research cutoff 2026-10-02; thesis horizon medium_term (1-3y)
routing_basis: A single-equity first pass whose central question is a numeric one (how much of reported growth is core), so it routes through equity-research-core with the valuation-expectation and earnings-quality overlays and a mandatory calculation gate.
routing_mismatch_risk: Medium - the company is a genuine technology leader but posted a -37.8% revenue year in 2023, so a steady-state growth framework would systematically overstate it; the framework is therefore growth-with-strict-core/non-core-separation rather than plain growth.
followup_questions: Does the Korean antitrust investigation resolve before the 2026Q3 report, and does it touch the interconnect royalty stream rather than only the Korean office? (Rung A -> risk variable and readiness_level)
Is the 2026Q2 single-quarter gross margin, currently derived by differencing cumulative YTD, confirmed or revised by the company's own Q3 disclosure? (Rung B -> earnings-quality overlay, closes G05)
Does 2026Q3 扣非 yoy growth hold near the H1 rate of +21.17%, or does the reported-vs-core gap start to close? (Rung B -> the central yes/no on this case)
At what price and multiple does the reverse-expectations anchor flip from 'already embeds the ramp' to 'mispriced'? (Rung C -> valuation-expectation overlay and actionability)
